## [Agentic Commerce in CPG: From Consumer Discovery to Enterprise Response](https://syrencloud.com/blogs/agentic-commerce-cpg-consumer-discovery-enterprise-response/)

Agentic commerce is reshaping how consumers discover and buy products. Drawing on Rajib, our VP Sales’ perspective, explore how CPG companies can prepare for both consumer AI agents and enterprise AI agents, connecting demand with faster commercial decisions.

## [The Syren AEGIS Framework](https://syrencloud.com/blogs/the-syren-aegis-framework/)

Agentic AI in BFSI depends on more than model capability. Syren’s AEGIS Framework provides a five-phase approach to assess data readiness, engineer trustworthy foundations, govern agent actions, instrument decisions for auditability, and scale autonomy only when the evidence supports it.

## [The Risk Detection Gap That’s Costing Pharma Billions](https://syrencloud.com/blogs/clinical-trial-supply-chain-risk-detection-gap/)

Heena Jain, Director of Supply Chain Solutions & Strategy at Syren, explains why a 6-week detection gap exists in clinical trial supply chains, and how AI closes it before patients are impacted.

## [Syren Sales Journey AI: Dynamic Field Sales Planning Powered by Databricks Lakebase](https://syrencloud.com/blogs/syren-sales-journey-ai-databricks-field-sales-planning/)

Traditional journey cycle plans become outdated the moment they’re published. Syren Sales Journey AI uses Databricks, Lakebase, and AI-driven dealer scoring to create dynamic, continuously optimized field sales plans that improve productivity, sales performance, and decision-making across distribution-driven industries.
